bug_semantics: Heap buffer overflow in csp_eth_init() (src/drivers/eth/eth_linux.c): the Linux Ethernet driver calloc()s eth_context_t with name[CSP_IFLIST_NAME_MAX+1] (11 bytes; CSP_IFLIST_NAME_MAX=10) and then strcpy(ctx->name, ifname) with no length check. A caller-supplied ifname longer than 10 bytes writes past the heap object. Issue #850 includes an ASan heap-buffer-overflow on that strcpy; PR #852 restores a bounded strncpy.
flaw_origin: The overflow was first written by 307f4077288fe0da04843ef26b98ab0b5cf44596 (Troels Jessen, 2023-09-05), a one-line edit that replaced the existing bounded strncpy(ctx->name, ifname, sizeof(ctx->name)-1) with unbounded strcpy(ctx->name, ifname). Parent be2fc46417fee1c5180b0c33345a86024692d966 still has the strncpy. The original bounded copy was introduced with csp_eth_init in 378dc98e2a19a6bccc8c24c251efb4248cc691b3; 307f407 is the smallest commit that first wrote the vulnerable strcpy line.
